name: Frame Window Counter
description: Load a macro, count the frame window of every input, and show them as circles with a running tally. Can render the result to video.

macro-file.name: Macro file
macro-file.description: The macro to analyse. Supported: <cy>.gdr</c> and <cy>.gdr2</c>, GDR <cy>.json</c>, Silicate <cy>.slc</c>, and this mod's own <cy>.fwc.json</c>. The format is detected from the file itself, not its name.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description:
<cy>Play macro</c>: this mod plays the macro and shows the windows.
<cy>Overlay only</c>: another bot plays the macro; this mod only shows the windows.
<cy>Count windows</c>: works out the frame window of every input on the next attempt, saves them next to the macro, then switches back to Play macro.
<cy>Render video</c>: plays the macro and writes a video with the overlay through ffmpeg, then switches back to Play macro.

frame-offset.name: Frame offset
frame-offset.description: Shifts every input by this many ticks. Different bots number frames slightly differently; if the macro dies early when played back, try 1 or -1.

markers.name: Circles
markers.description: Draw a circle with the frame window where each input happens.

max-shown-window.name: Largest window to mark
max-shown-window.description: Inputs with a bigger frame window than this get no circle.

marker-seconds.name: Circle lifetime (seconds)
marker-seconds.description: How long each circle stays, in level time. 0 keeps them until the attempt restarts.

hud.name: Tally
hud.description: Show how many 1-frame, 2-frame, ... inputs have gone by out of the total, in the top left.

max-window.name: Stop counting at
max-window.description: Windows are counted up to this many frames; anything wider is recorded as this value and shown with a plus.

horizon.name: Survival check (ticks)
horizon.description: After moving an input, the run has to survive until this many ticks past the following input for that position to count. 48 ticks is 0.2 seconds.

count-releases.name: Count releases
count-releases.description: Count the frame window of button releases as well as presses.

use-checkpoints.name: Use practice checkpoints
use-checkpoints.description: Much faster: each test replays from a recent checkpoint instead of the start of the level. Turn off if results look wrong on a level; counting will then take far longer.

count-speed.name: Counting speed (ticks per frame)
count-speed.description: How many physics ticks to simulate per drawn frame while counting. Higher is faster but makes the game less responsive.

ffmpeg-path.name: ffmpeg
ffmpeg-path.description: Path to the ffmpeg program. Leave empty if ffmpeg is on your PATH. Windows and macOS only.
